term: intrinsic existence reason of the proposed necessary ground
definition: Monadology §45 describes the necessary being proposed as the final reason for contingent beings as having the reason of its existence in itself. This does not mean efficient self-production, and it is not supplied by the bare modal predicate NecessaryAt. Whether the proposed nature actually exists and adequately explains itself remains to be defended.
